|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">旧共和国の古参士官であったが、クローン大戦の後で前線を退いた。アウターリムで偵察技術を教えて生計をたてている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Solomahal.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. Deploy on any warrior to give scout skill; that warrior may move to an adjacent location card as a react. Or deploy on any scout; that scout is power +2 when reacting. This Effect is not affected by Alter.

'''Lore:'''
A veteran officer of the Old Republic who left the front after the Clone Wars. He makes a living in the Outer Rim teaching scouting skills.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Functions are numbered 1/2 under どちらかを選ぶ instead of OR.
